claim_summary: For the d-dimensional optimal universal cloner, the canonical same-effect broadcaster-slice comparator has exact best Dirichlet constant c_slice(d)=2+(3d+4)/(2(d+1)^2), attained by an isotropic rank-one POVM.
The local branch CP condition 2 Lambda_y - R_y >=CP 0 is impossible for every nonzero qubit POVM effect, by two incompatible principal Choi diagonal constraints.

These are route obstructions only: the independent Haar EB depolarizing channel achieves c=2 for every universal cloner dimension, including explicit six-Pauli and peer-attributed qutrit realizations.
